regime_context: The TSX detector shows Big Banks leading with moderate durability (0.66) and high breadth (0.86) amid broad rotation (11/16 themes eligible, no single dominant narrative). The absolute-trend gate, which historically trimmed drawdowns in this market, validates eligible themes like Banks, while momentum ranks serve only as a focus lens.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks benefit from broad-based momentum (breadth 0.86) and staying power (trend-gate eligible, durability 0.66) within a motile but not one-narrative rotation. We lean overweight, accepting the absolute-trend gate’s validated risk-control edge, while acknowledging the rank is not a return forecast.
evidence: Rank 1, eligible via trend-gate (validated drawdown reduction)
Headline of rotation with clear margin over challenger
theses.dissent: A sudden macro shock (unscheduled-surprise share = 1.0) could hit rate-sensitive banks; crowded Insurers suggest reflexive risk across Financials, and the broad rotation signal may fizzle if absorption stays low.

falsifier.text: If Big Banks become ineligible (trend-gate failure) and breadth falls below 0.5 within the next 10 trading days.

theses.dissent: Geopolitical uncertainty (dominant macro theme) could trigger a flight-to-safety rally in precious metals, lifting royalty companies quickly.

falsifier.text: If Silver & Royalties becomes eligible (trend-gate true) and durability bar moves above 0.4 within the 20-day horizon.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners fail the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false), despite a strong Hurst ‘trend’ tag, meaning the absolute price trend is insufficient to pass the gate. This implies elevated risk of mean-reversion or drawdown. We lean avoid per the validated risk-control framework.

theses.dissent: Gold could benefit from geopolitics or falling real yields, and the ‘trend’ tag suggests internal momentum; macro surprises may catapult the group higher.

falsifier.text: If Gold Miners become eligible and durability bar climbs above 0.5 within 20 trading days, invalidating the avoidance.
